Amelia (sec): Vendor requests a 2.5h retest window Wed Apr 7 23:30-02:00 UTC. Goal: validate fixes for CVE-2026-0421 and CVE-2026-0999. Need agreement on RBAC scope, ephemeral KMS key issuance, audit snapshot, and evidence manifest.
Omar (SRE): Works for oncall as long as we have a clear rollback and a no-deploy freeze. Can we do a dry run a day before? :calendar:
Kevin (infra): Dry run makes sense. For KMS, prefer issuing an ephemeral key via the internal key-manager API (no long-lived IAM creds). Sample command:
```
curl -X POST https://keymgr.internal/api/v1/keys 
 -H "Authorization: Bearer $OP_TOKEN" \ 
 -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
 -d '{"name":"pt-assessor-1865439999","ttl":"3h","allowed_services":["s3","kms-encrypt"],"tags":{"pt_run":"1865439999","assessor":"vendor-acct"}}'
```
Kevin (infra): Response will include `key_ref` and `signed_token` for the assessor. We'll expire it at window end and emit a revoke event.
Nadia (eng): On RBAC, we'll create a timeboxed RoleBinding in namespace `pt-run-1865439999` with subject `user:assessor@vendor.com` and permission set: get/list/watch pods, get secrets:metadata. No exec, no port-forwarding. I'll open the PR and add smoke commands.
Amelia (sec): Good. Policy points: 1) Assessor gets only namespaced view to `pt-run-1865439999`, 2) No SSH or kube-proxy access, 3) All assessor activity forwarded to retest audit bucket.
Jules (legal): NDA check: vendor NID-889 still valid through May. Assessor contractor has signed addendum. I can re-send the cert if you need it.
Omar (SRE): For audit forwarding, target: s3://pt-retest-evidence/1865439999 with server-side encryption and 180d retention. ci-bot, can you snapshot current audit config and attach a manifest?
ci-bot: Snapshot created: https://ci.internal/artifacts/pt-1865439999/audit-snapshot.json (SHA256: ab12...ef). Manifest will include `start_ts`, `end_ts`, `included_services`, `pt_run_id`.
Amelia (sec): Evidence manifest template (please review):
```json
{
  "pt_run_id": "1865439999",
  "assessor": "vendor-acct",
  "artifact_bucket": "s3://pt-retest-evidence/1865439999",
  "files": ["audit.log.gz","key_create_event.json","rbac_pr.diff","revoke_event.json"],
  "signature": "<team-signature>"
}
```
Nadia (eng): I'll hook the PR to the pentest board. PR link will be: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/4872 and it will include smoke tests:
- `kubectl auth can-i get pods --as=assessor@vendor.com -n pt-run-1865439999`
- `aws s3 ls s3://pt-retest-evidence/1865439999 --profile assessor-token`
Omar (SRE): Add a temporary Grafana alert: page on >10% auth 5xx increase or failed audit forwarding. I'll add in the runbook.
Kevin (infra): Post-window tasks: revoke the ephemeral key, rotate any related service keys, and publish a signed revocation statement to the artifact bucket. We should include `revocation_signature` in the manifest.
Amelia (sec): audit-bot, list required audit event fields for evidence package (create/revoke/key-use + RBAC-change events).
audit-bot: Include fields: `event_id`, `timestamp`, `actor`, `action`, `resource_type`, `resource_id`, `pt_run_id`, `assessor_id`, `request_payload_hash`, `signature`. Will place sample events in the runbook folder.
Nadia (eng): Regarding vulnerabilities: will mark fixes in the tracker as follows: TICKET-4321 (CVE-2026-0421) -> PR #4870 (merged to staging), TICKET-4555 (CVE-2026-0999) -> PR #4872 (awaiting retest label). When label `pt:fix-verified` is applied, automation moves the ticket to column "Ready for Retest".
Amelia (sec): Operational constraints: assessor may comment on issues but cannot create new issues or merge PRs. All assessor-originating PRs must be opened as draft and reviewed by security triage.
Jules (legal): I'll re-attach the NDA and send the assessor contact to Amelia.
Omar (SRE): Rollback SRO: if auth failures >10% or data-exfil indicators, execute rollback job `pt-retest-rollback-1865439999` (one-click in console). I'll prep the script and run the dry run tomorrow at 09:00 UTC.
Nadia (eng): I'll add the smoke test checklist and a post-apply verifier to the PR: check rbac, check s3 write/read, and check audit event presence.
Amelia (sec): Summary checklist for owners: 
- Open RBAC PR (Nadia) -> PR #4872
- Issue ephemeral key and token (Kevin) -> key_ref in runbook
- Snapshot audits + manifest (ci-bot) -> artifact link
- Deploy freeze & rollback job (Omar) -> console job ready
- Legal confirm NDA & assessor contact (Jules)
Please react with :white_check_mark: when you own your item.
Nadia (eng): :white_check_mark:
Kevin (infra): :white_check_mark:
Omar (SRE): :white_check_mark:
Jules (legal): :white_check_mark: (sent NDA)
Amelia (sec): I'll schedule the planning call and the dry run invite. Will post the final runbook to: https://runbooks.internal/pt/1865439999 when complete. Thanks.
